coordinate_system: Unity world, Y-up; positions and vectors as in face_spec.json

rules.wall_filter: |n.y|<0.3, size area>=20m2, normal faces nearest walkable floor (level interior); stair sides excluded
rules.wall_run: one piece every 4-6m along face u; CABLE_TRAY_2m/CONDUIT_RUN_3m/VENT_GRILLE_1m/ACCESS_HATCH_0.8m rotate
rules.wall_pairs: JUNCTION_BOX + SIGN_PLATE every 12m (waist preferred, shifted out of collisions)
rules.wall_pipes: PIPE_VERTICAL_3m every 18m, bottom on floor, full-height occupancy
rules.platform_edges: RAILING_2m every 2m along /Beam/ and /Arch/ isWalkable outline edges; stairs/pillar tops/wall tops excluded
rules.scale: deterministic 0.95-1.05; railings scale to slot/2 clamped 0.95-1.05
rules.orientation: wall forward = wall normal facing level interior; mount_normal = -forward; railings forward = outward edge normal
